Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a temporary homeless status certification.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a temporary homeless statuscertification; and adding a new section to chapter 43.185C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.185CRCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall provide a temporary homeless statuscertificate form to any homeless person in the state who may need toprovide a physical or mailing address for the purpose of obtaining ormaintaining employment. The certificate must be provided in the formand manner prescribed by the department and must include: (a) The person's full name, age, date and place of birth (ifknown), social security number if available, and the information on anydriver's license or identification card issued by any state that theperson may possess; (b) A signed declaration by the person stating that he or she ishomeless and currently resides at a particular address or a specificphysical location in the state; and (c) A declaration by a temporary housing or homeless serviceprovider located in the state affirming that the person is homeless, p. 1 HB 2415providing the particular address or the specific physical locationwhere the person currently resides, and listing the provider's physicaland mailing address. (2) The certificate form must be filed with the department withinten days of completion. Upon verification of the information providedon the form, the department shall certify the address of the temporaryhousing or homeless service provider for the homeless person. Thecertification allows a homeless person to use the provider's address ashis or her own address for purposes of completing a job application oras otherwise required by a prospective or current employer. (3) The certification must expire one year from the date it iscertified by the department, except that the department may renew itfor up to an additional six months upon written request by thetemporary housing or homeless service provider. The department mayperiodically check with the provider on the current location of aperson. If the department finds that the person is no longer homeless,it may cancel the certification at any time. (4) The department may integrate the information gathered in thissection with the homeless client management information system. Thedepartment must publish and circulate the certificate form to temporaryhousing and homeless service providers throughout the state. (5) The certification may not be used as proof of residency in thisstate for purposes of obtaining a state driver's license or identicard,for voter registration, or for any other purpose than those describedin this section.
